sourcePolicy: Three API 653 report lineages assigned to validation by content_family_stratified_asset_lineage_70_15_15_v1; none appears in the v3 development set or the earlier nine-report robustness source list.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: To carry out thickness measurements on roof plates with a minimum of five (5) readings per plate (Wherever access and surface condition permit).
cases.classifierInput: Roof plates: take at least five thickness readings on each plate wherever access and the surface allow.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: To carry out side wall inspection utilizing an Ultrasonic Crawler at four (4) compass points with a minimum of five (5) readings per strake.
cases.classifierInput: Use the UT crawler on the side wall at four compass positions, with no fewer than five readings per strake.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Year Built: 1971 (Estimated)
cases.classifierInput: Build year is estimated as 1971.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Service Height: 9.14 m for Assessment
cases.classifierInput: Use a service height of 9.14 m for the assessment.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Construction (Shell): Butt-welded
cases.classifierInput: The shell courses are butt welded.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Pipework and supports were found to have experienced coating failure with subsequent corrosion on some areas.
cases.classifierInput: Some of the pipework and supports around the bund have failed coating with corrosion underneath.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Two (2) Earth grounding points were attached to the tank; one on the North which was found broken and another one on the South.
cases.classifierInput: There are two tank earth points; the north one is broken and the south one remains in place.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Fire water pipe attached to the shell plate on the West Sector beside the Varec Gauge was found perforated.
cases.classifierInput: West side beside the Varec gauge: the firewater pipe fixed to the shell plate is perforated.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Fire water pipe found perforated should be replaced.
cases.classifierInput: Replace the perforated firewater pipe.

cases.sourceReport: 19PE1-6 TK BE 2 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Calibration Standard: A.S. 2083 Calibration Blocks and Their Method of Use in Ultrasonic Testing
cases.classifierInput: The ultrasonic calibration procedure follows AS 2083 for calibration blocks and their use.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Year Built: 1973
cases.classifierInput: Tank construction year: 1973.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Service Height: 3.6 m
cases.classifierInput: Service level is 3.6 metres high.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: No plinth seal was found install on the edge projection plate.
cases.classifierInput: No plinth seal is installed along the floor edge projection.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Earthing points were found to have been wrapped with greased fabric tape. Labeled as tested in March 2015 with a resistance of 4 ohms.
cases.classifierInput: Foundation earthing points are wrapped in greased fabric tape and marked as tested in March 2015 at 4 ohms.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: All shell nozzles over 2 inches were found to have re-enforcing pads attached, however none contain tell tale holes, therefore have not been pressure tested.
cases.classifierInput: Shell nozzles above 2 inches have reinforcement pads, but none has a tell-tale hole and the pads were not pressure tested.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Scattered topside pittings were evident on the roof with a maximum depth of approximately 2 mm as measured by pit gauge.
cases.classifierInput: Scattered roof topside pits measured up to about 2 mm deep with the pit gauge.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Isolated spot coating failure with subsequent surface corrosion spotted on the 1st course adjacent to floor plate 3.1c.
cases.classifierInput: Inside shell course 1 beside floor plate 3.1c, one isolated coating failure has surface corrosion below it.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Severely corroded pipe supports should be replaced.
cases.classifierInput: Replace the pipe supports that are severely corroded.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Routine In-Service Inspection should be carried out at least monthly to monitor closely the external condition of the tank.
cases.classifierInput: Check the external tank condition in service at least once each month.

cases.sourceReport: 15PIE1-3 TK RA 3 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Flaw Detector: Epoch 4 (S/N IRS 3167)
cases.classifierInput: UT instrument used: Epoch 4 flaw detector, serial IRS 3167.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Year Built: 1985
cases.classifierInput: Recorded build year is 1985.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Service Height: Not Provided
cases.classifierInput: No service-height value was supplied.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Shell Nozzles S1 (2 inches) and S2 (6 inches) neck thicknesses did not seem to comply with API 650 Table 5.6a Column 3.
cases.classifierInput: Shell nozzle necks S1 at 2 inches and S2 at 6 inches appear below the API 650 Table 5.6a column 3 requirement.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Spiral stairway attached to TK 2 was found corroded and broken on many locations.
cases.classifierInput: The spiral stairs connected to TK 2 are corroded and broken at several points.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Tank roof seemed to be reconstructed judging from the roof plates weldments, however no confirmation was provided from the Tank Owner.
cases.classifierInput: The roof plate welds suggest the roof was rebuilt, but the owner has not confirmed this.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: 3 inch nozzle R3 was not able to be assessed by Ultrasonic Testing due to the uneven surface and contour of the nozzle.
cases.classifierInput: UT could not assess the 3-inch roof nozzle R3 because its surface and contour are uneven.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: The entire roof supporting structure was viewed from the floor. Condition was found to be satisfactory with no visible mechanical damage evident.
cases.classifierInput: From floor level, the internal roof supports looked satisfactory with no visible mechanical damage.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: A mechanical dent was found measuring approximately 25 mm in diameter on Plate 2.6.
cases.classifierInput: Floor plate 2.6 has a mechanical dent roughly 25 mm across.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Acceptance Criteria: API 653 4th Ed, April 2009
cases.classifierInput: For the shell ultrasonic thickness test, use API 653 fourth edition, April 2009 as the acceptance criterion.

cases.sourceReport: 18PE2-4 TK 5 Internal & External Inspection Report.pdf
cases.sourceText: Calibration Standard: A.S. 2083 Calibration Blocks and Their Method of Use in Ultrasonic Testing
cases.classifierInput: Ultrasonic calibration followed AS 2083 for the blocks and their method of use.
